info.name: BookSphere - Fine Service
info.description:
Postman collection for Fine Service (BS-BE-07).

Recommended run order:
1. 00 - Auth Setup
2. 01 - Internal Fine API - Direct Service
3. 02 - Fine Query - Via Gateway
4. 03 - Payment Flow - Via Gateway
5. 04 - Fine API - Direct Service
6. 05 - Gateway Security

Prerequisites: Auth, Borrow, Fine, Gateway running. Seed fine id=1 UNPAID.
Note: Payment SUCCESS marks fine as PAID; reset DB to rerun payment folder.
